companies.name: アンテロ・ミッドストリーム

relations.text: 集ガス・圧縮をAntero Midstreamに委託(WV・OHの鉱区をほぼすべて専用契約)
relations.text_en: Dedicates substantially all its West Virginia and Ohio acreage to Antero Midstream for gathering

source.label: Antero Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we have dedicated to Antero Midstream substantially all of our current and future acreage in West Virginia and Ohio for gathering and compression services.

relations.text: Antero Midstream株の29%を保有(持分法)
relations.text_en: Owns 29% of Antero Midstream's common stock

source.label: Antero Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we owned 29% of Antero Midstream's common stock.

relations.text: MPLX傘下MarkWestとガス処理の契約、Antero Midstreamとの合弁も
relations.text_en: Contracts with MPLX's MarkWest for gas processing; MarkWest is Antero Midstream's JV partner

source.label: Antero Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The joint venture entered into on February 6, 2017 between Antero Midstream Partners, a wholly owned subsidiary of Antero Midstream and MarkWest, a wholly owned subsidiary of MPLX, LP, to develop processing and fractionation assets in Appalachia.

relations.text_en: Holds firm capacity on Enterprise's ATEX pipeline

source.label: Antero Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: (x) Enterprise Products Partners ATEX Pipeline ("ATEX") and (xi) Sunoco Pipeline ("Mariner East 2"). Our diverse portfolio of firm capacity gives us the flexibility

relations.text: HG Energyの上流事業を28億ドルで買収する契約(2025年12月)
relations.text_en: Agreed to buy HG Energy's upstream business for $2.8 billion (Dec 2025)

source.label: Antero Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On December 5, 2025, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of the issued and outstanding equity interests of HG Energy II Production Holdings, LLC ("HG Production") from HG Energy II LLC ("HG Energy") for total cash consideration of $2.8 billion

relations.text: オハイオの上流資産をInfinityとNorthernに売却(2026年2月完了)
relations.text_en: Sold Ohio upstream assets to Infinity and Northern (closed Feb 2026)

source.label: Infinity Natural Resources 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On February 23, 2026, we completed the acquisitions ("Antero Acquisition") of (i) certain rights, title and interests in upstream oil and gas properties, rights and related assets located in the State of Ohio (the "Upstream Assets") from Antero Resources Corporation
